data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old English 'ma dus,' meaning 'mother's powerful one' or 'maid servant.' Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Maudie usually hope their child will grow to embody little servant and live with faith, good character and purpose.

The name symbolizes strength, faithfulness, and dedication to one's purpose, which aligns with Christian values. Maudie's name implies a servant's heart that seeks to serve God and her fellow human beings with love and compassion. Moreover, the name evokes the image of the Blessed Virgin Mary, who served as the perfect servant and mother to God and humanity. Thus, the name Maudie holds a special significance for Christians who value faithfulness, service, and devotion.
